info.title: Stellar MicroPay API
info.description:
Backend API for Stellar MicroPay — instant micropayments on the Stellar network.

## Rate Limiting

All endpoints are rate-limited. Three limiters apply:

| Limiter | Window | Limit | Routes |
|---------|--------|-------|--------|
| Global | 15 minutes | 100 req/IP | All routes |
| Strict | 1 minute | 20 req/IP | `/api/analytics/*`, `/api/tips/*`, `/api/webhooks/*`, `/federation`, `/api/accounts/register` |
| Payment | 1 minute | 10 req/IP | `/api/payments/*`, `/api/turrets/*` |

Every response includes the following headers so clients can implement back-off:

| Header | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `RateLimit-Limit` | Maximum requests allowed in the current window |
| `RateLimit-Remaining` | Requests remaining before the limit is reached |
| `RateLimit-Reset` | Seconds until the window resets |

When the limit is exceeded the server returns **HTTP 429** with `{ "error": "Too many requests, please try again later." }`. Clients should read `RateLimit-Remaining` on each response and add exponential back-off when the value approaches 0.

get.description: Ranks the top 5 recipients by total XLM sent, counting sent payments from the account's most recent payments (up to 200), sorted descending by total. Results are cached for 60 seconds.

200.description: Top recipients by total XLM sent

topRecipients.description: Up to 5 entries, highest total first.

totalXLMSent.description: Total XLM sent to the recipient

get.summary: Get payment activity by day of week
get.description: Counts the account's most recent payments (up to 200) by day of week, always returning all seven days (Sunday first). Results are cached for 60 seconds.

200.description: Payment counts for each day of the week

dayIndex.description: Day of week index (0 = Sunday, 6 = Saturday)

transactionCount.description: Number of payments on that day

get.description: Groups the account's most recent payments (up to 200) into calendar buckets and reports, per bucket, how many counterparties appeared once versus more than once, split by sent and received payments. Results are cached for 60 seconds.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Bucket size for the cohort breakdown. Defaults to month; any value other than week falls back to month.

parameters.name: periods
parameters.description: How many buckets to return, ending with the current period. Defaults to 6; values below 1 or that are not numeric fall back to 6, and values above 12 are capped at 12.

get.summary: Stream new payment events as server-sent events
get.description: Opens a text/event-stream connection that emits `event: payment` with a JSON payment payload for each new operation, `event: error` with `{ message }` when the underlying Horizon stream fails, and a `: heartbeat` comment every 25 seconds.

200.description: Server-sent event stream. Each `payment` event carries a PaymentStreamEvent payload; `error` events carry `{ message }`.

get.description: Returns the stored export schedule for the account, or `data: null` when no schedule has been created.

200.description: Export schedule, or null when none exists

post.description: Creates or replaces the recurring email export schedule for the account. Schedules are held in memory, so they do not survive a server restart.

400.description: Missing email/frequency, frequency other than 'daily' or 'weekly', invalid Stellar public key format, or malformed JSON body

post.description: Sends the export email immediately using the account's stored schedule. Fails with 404 when no schedule exists for the account.

get.description: Resolves a Stellar address to an account ID (type=name) or an account ID to a Stellar address (type=id), per SEP-0002. Queries for local federation domains are answered from the local username registry; queries for other domains are forwarded to the federation server advertised by that domain's stellar.toml and the external response body is returned unchanged.
